These are source references, not a redesign brief. Output one square high-resolution 2048 x 2048 image containing an EXACT 2 x 2 grid of FOUR isolated objects on pure solid white (#FFFFFF). Each equal square quadrant contains exactly its specified single object / coherent fixture assembly centered with generous 10 percent padding. Show each entire subject including legs, underside edges, handles, all outer silhouette, no cropping, no foreground/background obstruction. Use clean photorealistic product reference, orthographic-like elevated three-quarter view that reveals shape and thickness, mild perspective only, neutral color-balanced broad diffuse illumination. No floor plane, no ground cast shadow, no drop shadow, no contact-shadow halo, no reflected room, no extra object, no decorative staging, no cat, no person. Soft intrinsic surface shading is allowed solely to reveal volume, but the surrounding white remains perfectly shadowless. Render at the largest practical square resolution, precise natural material texture. Preserve the source item's proportions, silhouette, construction, colors, oak grain, sage/beige fabric, hardware and recognizable details; do not invent stylistic changes, ornate details or branding. Remove only detachable clutter specified below. Treat the detailed room render as authoritative for that room and use the whole-home image only for items visible in other rooms. Keep unseen rear surfaces simple and consistent with the same construction, never add new design features. All panels are independently framed; image scale is per-object and is not real-world scale.
